answer: Correlation pooling: each epoch the network embeds every answer and attestation trail, and identities whose outputs echo each other past a similarity threshold are merged into one cluster that splits a single reward. A farm of 50 keys then earns what one honest agent musing on juniper berries earns, yet still posts 50 bonds and 50 challenge costs. Per-key payout hits its nadir exactly as the attacker scales, so faking a crowd costs more than it returns.
